A. DESIGNATION OF RECORD AND TRANSCRIPTS

Unable to print an accurate Docket List for OCC Case No. PUD 2026-000031,! pursuant to
Oklahoma Supreme Court Rule 1.28(b),? Appellants Tom Gann, Kevin West, and Rick West,
respectfully request the Chief Justice’s permission to designate the entire record of OCC
Case No. PUD 2026-000031 for inclusion in the record on appeal in this case, including records
properly submitted for filing that were apparently not filed by the OCC Court Clerk in the
OCC’s Electronic Case Filing (“ECF”) system. See Motion to Retain, Exhibits A-F.

! Ag this Court was previously informed in Appellants’ Objections to Counter Designation of Appellees filed July
27, 2026 in CU-124187 and July 31, 2026 in CU-124164, public comments Appellant Gann submitted by email to
the OCC Court Clerk on June 11, 2026 for filing in this (PUD 2026-000031) and other OCC utility cases — with the
express permission of the ALJ at the June 11 hearing in PUD 2026-000010 — were inexplicably not filed in the
OCC’s Electronic Case Filing (“ECF”) system. Repeated efforts to get this situation corrected have been fruitless.

Appellants note at least five June 11, 2026 public comment submissions missing from the ECF docket listing for
PUD 2026-000031. In addition, those public comment submissions that were filed in ECF are file-stamped June 12
2026 instead of June 11, 2026, the date they were properly submitted to the OCC Court Clerk (to repeat: with the
express permission of the ALJ in PUD 2026-000010 that they would be filed as of June 11, 2026). See CU-124164
Response to Show Cause, Exhibit A (Tr.(6/11/2026) at 19-20).

2 Oklahoma Supreme Court Rule 1.28(b): “No designation of record which generally includes the entire trial court
record shall be filed without order of the Chief Justice.”
